windows.cause: WASH_SALE_CARRY_OVER: 1 lot(s) opened after the window's first day carry a custodian basis above the cash paid by the loss disallowed on an earlier sale (disallowed_loss_amount, acquired_date tacked back before orgpurch_date), a basis no cash moved for; 0 closed lot(s) of the window carried one. Each is measured from the cash paid (cost_basis_unamortized less disallowed_loss_amount) on every day it is open and where it closes; the custodian's figure stays in custodian_cost_basis

WASH_SALE_CARRY_OVER: 4 lot(s) opened after the window's first day carry a custodian basis above the cash paid by the loss disallowed on an earlier sale (disallowed_loss_amount, acquired_date tacked back before orgpurch_date), a basis no cash moved for; 6 closed lot(s) of the window carried one. Each is measured from the cash paid (cost_basis_unamortized less disallowed_loss_amount) on every day it is open and where it closes; the custodian's figure stays in custodian_cost_basis

CUSTODIAN_RESELECTED_THE_LOTS_RELIEVED_BY_AN_IN_KIND_DEPARTURE: the leg of 2500 shares posts on 2026-09-02 with one selection of lots; on 2026-09-03 the table shows another selection (2 lots out, 1 in) of the same security with the share count unchanged at 8654, no leg and no sale, and the remaining basis moved by 2305.00. The shares relieved are the leg's; the basis relieved is the table's before the departure less its basis after the re-selection, so the departure gain is trued up by that change on the day of the re-selection (the quantity ties to the leg on both days)

WASH_SALE_CARRY_OVER: 1 lot(s) opened after the window's first day carry a custodian basis above the cash paid by the loss disallowed on an earlier sale (disallowed_loss_amount, acquired_date tacked back before orgpurch_date), a basis no cash moved for; 0 closed lot(s) of the window carried one. Each is measured from the cash paid (cost_basis_unamortized less disallowed_loss_amount) on every day it is open and where it closes; the custodian's figure stays in custodian_cost_basis
